notes: Audited against Engrossed-in-House (EH) source text. One material issue: likelihoodReason asserts the bill 'was ordered reported without amendment by the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee', but no Senate committee action is in the bill source or the cache (versions stop at 'Referred in Senate'; stage still 'house'; votes[] has only the House voice vote) — a concrete extrinsic status claim with no registered source. Minor items: the recurring 'categorical exclusion' label for Section 8 (accurate in reality but not in the bill text; 42 U.S.C. 15942 / Section 390 was not fetched, referencedSources empty) and unsourced procedural framing in likelihoodReason ('under suspension of the rules', breadth-of-support, forecasts). Two minor omissions: the Section 4 five-year report and the Section 6(d) Ombudsman annual report. All operative provisions (60-day deadline, cost recovery through 9/30/2033, Ombudsman/Task Force + 25% retention cap, Gold Book update/rename, royalty in-service-date shift, Section 390 geothermal add) are faithfully and correctly rendered, with figures and directions matching source.
